verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim strong 4K performance via DLSS4/Multi Frame Generation, RT/Tensor cores, and Reflex responsiveness, and an independent review (TechPowerUp) corroborates 'good gaming performance' with all new RTX 50 features, plus an HN discussion noting substantially higher geomean benchmark scores vs prior gens. However, the independent evidence also flags gen-over-gen gains being smaller than expected and doesn't cite specific 4K high-refresh frame-rate benchmarks or resolution/refresh-specific numbers. Missing for 10: independent 4K high-refresh-rate benchmark data (e.g., specific FPS at 4K/144Hz across titles), and reviews directly validating DLSS4 frame-gen multiplier claims in real games.
